data.desc: A multiple times Golden Peacock award winner for Corporate Governance, and with AI at the core of our solutions portfolio, Sify is focussed on the changing ICT requirements of the emerging digital landscape and the resultant demands from large, mid and small-sized businesses. Sify's infrastructure comprising state-of-the-art data centers, the largest MPLS network, partnership with global technology majors and deep expertise in business transformation solutions modelled on the cloud, make it the first choice of large enterprises, start-ups and SMEs looking to scale. Businesses across multiple verticals have taken advantage of our unassailable trinity of Data Centers, Networks and Security services and conduct their business seamlessly from across India. Internationally, Sify has presence across North America, the United Kingdom and Singapore.
